Replaces Hunting Grounds. At battle start Homm3FortressPredatorInstinctRuntime pairs each melee stack (ranged too with Endurance Hunting) of a Fortress hero 1-to-1 with a random enemy stack; predators deal +33/66/100% damage to their prey and, while the prey lives, 17/33/50% less damage to other targets (counter hits included) inside the single committed-damage owner, and hovering a Fortress stack draws a blood-red line to its prey. Subskills: Swamp Tactics (native-terrain damage), Intimidation (Ice Bolt -3 Initiative on hit), Endurance Hunting, Frenzy (1-Focus Haste + taunt), Cautious (parry vs prey), Pounce (no retaliation from prey). Skill ranks keep only the runtime-owned load shape.
